name: The Olympic Club
location: San Francisco (Lake Merced, Skyline Boulevard and the Pacific bluffs), California
architects: Willie Watson and Sam Whiting (1924), Whiting rebuild 1927, Robert Trent Jones Sr. 1954, Bill Love 2009, Gil Hanse 2023

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM (3DEPElevation exportImage), x 543500-545600 / y 4172600-4174700 EPSG:32610, NAVD88 metres, clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-olympic_club)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project CA_SanFrancisco_B23 (CA_SanFrancisco_1_B23), 11 tiles, class 1 (the tiles carry classes 1, 2, 7, 9 and 20: no vegetation classes, so trees come from class 1 with roofs dropped by roof_last_share, as at Aberdeen and Newport); NAD83(2011) / San Francisco CS13 (EPSG:7131), NAVD88 m; clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-olympic_club)
laz.label: USGS 3DEP lidar (San Francisco)

layouts.name: The Olympic Club Lake
layouts.scorecard_source: Third-party (private club): GolfPass's Lake card (course 14938; par, men's and women's handicap and ten tee rows, the post-2023 Hanse card), read 2026-11-13; every row adds up to its printed total (Champ 7,214). Ratings: Champ 76.2/143 and Black 75.2/141 from 18Birdies (printed against 7,214 and 7,024); GolfPass's tee table gives 76.7/145 and 75.9/143 against 7,232 and 7,050. Unverified against the club's printed card.

attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Champ) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the Lake's own OSM boundary (way 1417078425), roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; open-coast wind 3-14 mph; trees from 3DEP lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. The Cliffs is its own course (data/olympic_club_cliffs: its boundary is in two parts either side of Skyline Boulevard, which a site with layouts can't join); the Ocean course is not built (its hole lines are dropped; its ground is scenery). Theme olympic_club (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1335 x 1421 m, relation/3573537) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (228 m west/east, 185 m south/north)

roof_last_share_note: class-1 lidar holds roofs: crowns whose returns are 85 %+ last returns are roofs, not trees (as Aberdeen, Newport and Wannamoisett)
tee_shot_note: tee_shot_margin_m: the tee-shot tree check keeps the ball 0.5 m clear of each crown; without it the check passed Lake 7 while the game's drive clipped a canopy 20 m out (course_play)
